entities.summary: Grover Sanders Krantz was an American anthropologist and cryptozoologist; he was one of the few scientists who have not only researched Bigfoot, but also expressed a belief in the animal's existence. Throughout his professional career, Krantz authored more than 60 academic articles and 10 books on human evolution, and conducted field research in Europe, China, and Java.
